summary_md: **Peter Dedene ([@dedene](https://x.com/dedene/status/2115720915833250186))** benchmarks the diffusion LLM **Clover-35B-A3B** on one DGX Spark: with thinking off it rarely calls tools, but with thinking on it is the best he has measured on a Spark (BFCL 89.6 / 61.5 multi-turn, AgentDojo 86.5, GPQA 78.3, 23 agent steps/min vs. 14 for Qwen3.8 FP4), though 49 of 200 prompt injections succeeded versus 2 for Qwen; the follow-up shares a Docker Compose setup with SGLang and a GB10-patched Clover PR ([dedene/Clover-35B-A3B-DGX-Spark](https://github.com/dedene/Clover-35B-A3B-DGX-Spark)).
relevance: Hands-on DGX Spark numbers for a new ~35B agent model, including security caveats.
